description: Benign benchmark corpus: widely used npm packages, pinned by version. Fetched with `npm pack` into benchmark/.cache (gitignored) on first run. The scanner must report zero HIGH/CRITICAL threats for each. Packages under knownFlagged are expected HIGH findings that are true by behaviour; they count as false positives in the numbers on purpose so the precision floor stays honest.

knownFlagged.esbuild@0.24.2: install.js downloads a platform binary, chmods and execs it, and serialises process.env for the npm registry request: behaviourally a dropper. Flagging it is correct; the difference from malware is the publisher.
knownFlagged.pm2@5.4.3: lib/HttpInterface.js is a process monitor that reports hostname, CPUs and network interfaces over HTTP by design. A host-fingerprint beacon looks the same from the outside.
